clue.text: Faint indication that white has won

definitions.meaning: to faint is to lose consciousness briefly
in chess or draughts, black being out of the game means white is the winner

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: a sudden loss of consciousness, and a phrase saying the dark side has been eliminated.

clue.text: Pay attention and watch this space!

definitions.meaning: a sharp call demanding someone's notice
taken literally: cast your eyes on this very spot

explanation.definitionFit: The exclamation is used to demand notice, and literally it tells someone to direct their eyes at a particular place.

clue.text: Unavoidable comment on a hopeless case

definitions.meaning: what is said of a person or situation past any assistance

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means inevitable, and literally describes someone no assistance could save.

clue.text: Refuse to perform operation on solicitor

indicators.note: in a down clue, 'on' places the first piece above, i.e. before, the second

parts.note: a tout solicits custom, so is literally one who solicits

explanation.surface: Someone declines to carry out surgery on their lawyer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Solicitor' suggests a British lawyer, but here it is a tout, someone who solicits business.
explanation.definitionFit: To opt out is to choose not to take part, declining to participate.

clue.text: Thanks business for supplying Mexican dish

parts.note: TA is British informal for thank you
CO is short for company, a business

explanation.surface: Gratitude to a firm for providing Mexican food.
explanation.walkthrough: TA is everyday British slang for thanks.
explanation.definitionFit: A folded tortilla with a filling is a staple of Mexican cuisine.

clue.text: Probably time to tuck into sausage pie

indicators.note: the letter for time is pushed inside the word sausage
printer's pie is a jumble of type, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: It's likely time to eat a sausage pie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to tuck into' puts T inside SAUSAGE, and 'pie' (printer's pie, jumbled type) scrambles the result into ATAGUESS. 'Pie' looks like part of the meal but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Roughly estimated, so likely but not certain; both phrases hedge a claim.

clue.text: Strike a Mongolian monk

parts.note: to lam is to beat or thrash someone

explanation.surface: Someone hits a Buddhist holy man from Mongolia.
explanation.definitionFit: Lamas are Buddhist clergy of Tibet and Mongolia.

clue.text: Prince Consort meets an inhabitant of Canada

parts.note: Albert was Queen Victoria's husband, the Prince Consort

explanation.surface: Queen Victoria's husband is introduced to a Canadian.
explanation.walkthrough: Prince Albert was Queen Victoria's husband; Alberta, named after his daughter, is a Canadian province.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from the Canadian province of Alberta is so called.

clue.text: Bottom of the class, despite exertions

definitions.meaning: the pupil ranked behind every other one
in spite of everything done or tried

explanation.definitionFit: Literally behind everybody else in rank, and as an idiom meaning nevertheless, in spite of everything.

clue.text: To carry out work at home is murder

parts.note: to do is to perform or carry out a task
IN means at home, not out

explanation.surface: Doing chores in the house is killing me.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is murder' sounds like a complaint about housework, but murder is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally, to do someone in is to kill them.

clue.text: Way to get painstakingly produced food

parts.note: thorough describes something done with great care
fare is food and drink provided

explanation.surface: How to obtain carefully prepared meals.
explanation.definitionFit: A main road or street through a place is a public route.

clue.text: US pioneer has to face riotous marines

parts.note: to front is to face

indicators.note: riotous suggests disorder, so the letters of the word marines are scrambled

explanation.surface: An American settler must face out-of-control soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: Settlers living at the edge of the American West were pioneers of the wilderness.

clue.text: Watch agent and consumer

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative or agent
an eater consumes food

explanation.surface: Keep an eye on the representative and the shopper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Watch' looks like a verb but is the noun: a repeater watch chimes the time on demand.
explanation.definitionFit: A repeater is a timepiece that strikes the hours when a button is pressed.

clue.text: It revolves in either direction

indicators.note: the word reads identically forwards and backwards, which is what in either direction points to

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Something turns both clockwise and anticlockwise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in either direction' seems to describe the spinning, but says the answer is a palindrome.
explanation.definitionFit: The rotating part of a helicopter or engine spins round a fixed axis.

clue.text: I get so distressed by his selfishness

definitions.note: the definition is the self-centred man himself, identified by his self-interest

indicators.note: distressed means upset or knocked out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is upset by a man's self-centred behaviour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distressed' rearranges I GET SO. The definition points to a man known for self-regard.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-centred person who puts their own interests first is characterised by selfishness.

clue.text: Retirement place given to English historian

parts.note: bed is where one retires at night

explanation.surface: A place to retire is offered to an English chronicler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retirement' suggests leaving work, but here it is going to bed. The Venerable Bede was an Anglo-Saxon monk who wrote an early history of England.
explanation.definitionFit: The Venerable Bede wrote the Ecclesiastical History of the English People.

clue.text: Support scouting group by providing hiking equipment

parts.note: to back is to support
a pack is a unit of Cub Scouts

explanation.surface: Help the Scouts by giving them walking gear.
explanation.definitionFit: A rucksack carried on a walking trip holds a hiker's kit.

clue.text: Criticises charges

definitions.meaning: to rate is, in an older sense, to scold severely
fees or prices set for something

explanation.definitionFit: To berate someone is an old sense of the verb; as a plural noun, the word means prices or tariffs.

clue.text: To the point, with regard to the Eastern Med

parts.note: RE means concerning
the Levant is the region bordering the eastern Mediterranean

explanation.surface: Something pertinent concerning the eastern Mediterranean.
explanation.definitionFit: Pertinent remarks bear directly on the matter at hand.

clue.text: Go and move car round

definitions.meaning: a go is a person's opportunity in a game
to rotate a vehicle to face another way

explanation.definitionFit: Your go in a game is your chance to play, and to steer a vehicle around is to change its direction.

clue.text: Campanologist accepts stone from corrupt antiques dealer

indicators.note: accepting means taking something inside, so one piece goes into the other

parts.note: a campanologist rings church bells, so is a ringer
ST is the abbreviation for stone, the weight

explanation.surface: A bell-ringer takes a gem from a dishonest dealer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' suggests stone is taken away, but it is a link. A ring is a group of dealers who agree not to bid against one another at auction; a member is a ringster.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a ring of dealers who fix auction prices is a cheat in the trade.

clue.text: Make fellow politician confront the Spanish

parts.note: co- is the prefix meaning fellow, as in co-worker
MP is a Member of Parliament
el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: Get another MP to face up to the Spaniards.
explanation.definitionFit: To force someone to do something is to oblige them.

clue.text: Cowardly army men captured in Cretan manoeuvres

indicators.note: captured in means held inside, so one piece is placed within another
manoeuvres suggests moving around, so the letters of Cretan are rearranged

parts.note: the Royal Engineers, the RE, are soldiers

explanation.surface: Timid soldiers are taken prisoner during exercises in Crete.
explanation.walkthrough: 'manoeuvres' turns CRETAN into RECANT, and 'captured in' puts RE inside it after REC.
explanation.definitionFit: A craven or faint-hearted person is literally one who has yielded.

clue.text: Is twice as able in dance

indicators.note: twice says the piece appears two times in a row

parts.note: to be able is to can, as in 'is able'

explanation.surface: Someone is doubly capable at dancing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Is ... able' means can, and 'twice' doubles it.
explanation.definitionFit: A high-kicking French dance of the music hall.

clue.text: To reward shareholders must be of benefit

definitions.meaning: to share company profits with investors
to bring rewards in the long run

explanation.definitionFit: Literally, firms distribute profit payments to investors; figuratively, an effort that brings later gains does so.

clue.text: Still the first person to see a mythical monster

parts.note: yet means still, as in 'not yet done'
I is the first-person pronoun

explanation.surface: Even now, the first one to spot a legendary beast.
explanation.definitionFit: The abominable snowman is a legendary ape-like creature said to live in the Himalayas.

clue.text: Dejected entrepreneur filled with depression

indicators.note: the phrase filled with says the letters lie inside the words dejected entrepreneur

explanation.surface: A downcast businessman is overcome by gloom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'depression' suggests low spirits, but it is a hollow; the answer straddles the two words.
explanation.definitionFit: A hollow pressed into a surface is a small dip.

clue.text: Lustreless Gospel writer cut short

indicators.note: cut short means the end of the name is lopped off

parts.note: Matthew wrote the first Gospel

explanation.surface: A dull evangelist has been abbreviated.
explanation.definitionFit: A matt finish is dull, without shine or gloss.

clue.text: Understand that the machine can now be threaded

definitions.text: that the machine can now be threaded
definitions.meaning: read literally: the sewing thread has been put on the machine

explanation.definitionFit: Informally, to catch on means to grasp; literally, yarn fitted to a sewing machine is put in place.

clue.text: An attempt on a small number of leaseholders

parts.note: ten is a small number
a try is an attempt

explanation.surface: Another go at a handful of renters.
explanation.definitionFit: Tenants collectively, those who rent land or property, form a body of renters.
